page_description: Track your installment purchases in one place; each posts as an expense every month and you always see how many are left.
empty_description: Bought something in installments? Add it here; it posts as an expense every month and you always see how many are left.
relief_title: Relief timeline — your monthly load drops by this much as plans end
close_confirmBody: The plan stops today; future installments won't post, past ones stay in your ledger. (Use this if you paid it off early at the bank.)
delete_confirmBody: The plan is deleted; already-posted installments stay in transactions.
form_modalSubtitle_create: Enter once; it posts monthly and ends on the last installment.
form_modalSubtitle_edit: Name, category and note can be changed.
locked_hint: Amount, count and start date are locked — delete and recreate the plan to change them.
toast_closed: Plan closed; future installments won't post.
